title: Wheelchair user + toddler in Vienna

turns.user: Vienna 4 days, 6-9 May 2027, from Helsinki. Two adults and a 2-year-old; my husband uses a wheelchair, so everything must be step-free. Mid budget about 2500 euros. Music, parks, cafes.
